jobs.description: About the roleAt 7Learnings , we help e-commerce businesses make smarter pricing decisions through AI-powered price optimization. As we continue to grow and expand internationally, building scalable and efficient revenue operations is essential to our success.As our Senior RevOps Manager , you will play a key role in building and scaling 7Learnings' revenue engine. Sitting within the Marketing team, you will work closely with our C-level, Marketing, Sales and Finance teams to create the processes, systems and data infrastructure that enable sustainable growth.You will take ownership of our Revenue Operations strategy and roadmap, ensuring that our Go-to-Market teams are aligned, efficient and equipped with the right tools and insights to succeed. From optimizing our HubSpot setup and automating workflows to building reliable reporting and forecasting structures, you will have the autonomy to shape how we operate across Germany, the UK and the US.This is a hands-on role with significant ownership and visibility across the company. You will have the opportunity to build scalable processes, identify opportunities for improvement and directly influence 7Learnings' commercial performance.Your missionYour mission is to build a scalable, data-driven revenue engine that connects Marketing, Sales and Finance and enables our international growth.In particular, you will:• Own the RevOps strategy: Develop and drive our Revenue Operations strategy and roadmap in alignment with the C-level and leadership team.• Optimize the revenue process: Design and manage the end-to-end revenue process, including lead routing, lifecycle and pipeline stages, and handovers between Marketing and Sales.• Drive data-driven decisions: Own pipeline reporting and forecasting, building the KPIs and dashboards leadership and the board rely on, including ARR, pipeline coverage, conversion rates, win rates and sales cycle metrics.• Own our GTM tech stack: Manage and continuously improve our Go-to-Market tools, including HubSpot, Apollo, n8n and Clay. Evaluate new tools, manage integrations and automations, and oversee the related budget.• Ensure data quality: Establish and maintain data governance standards to ensure accurate and consistent CRM and billing data in close collaboration with Finance.• Enable sales planning: Partner with Finance and Sales leadership on territory planning, capacity planning, quotas and commission structures.• Manage commission calculations: Take ownership of quarterly sales commission calculations, ensuring accuracy based on CRM data and agreed commission plans.• Scale internationally: Build and standardize revenue processes that support our growing teams across Germany, the UK and the US.• Drive continuous improvement: Proactively identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies in our revenue engine and develop actionable improvement proposals.• Enable our teams: Create clear documentation, onboarding materials and regular training to empower our Go-to-Market teams.• Deliver with accountability: Run RevOps as a service, with clearly defined scopes, committed delivery dates and transparent tracking of requests and projects.Your profileYou are a structured, analytical and proactive RevOps professional who enjoys turning complex processes and messy data into scalable systems. You combine strategic thinking with a hands-on mentality and take ownership from identifying a problem to delivering a solution.Ideally, you bring:• 3+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations or a similar role, preferably in a B2B SaaS scale-up.• Hands-on experience administering HubSpot, including workflows, properties, reporting and integrations.• Experience with Apollo, n8n and Clay is a strong plus.• Strong analytical skills and confidence working with complex or imperfect datasets. SQL or advanced spreadsheet skills are an advantage.• A structured, pragmatic and results-oriented mindset. You know how to scope projects, set realistic timelines and deliver on your commitments.• The ability to independently identify inefficiencies and proactively propose solutions rather than simply flagging problems.• Strong project management skills and the ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and priorities.• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical systems and processes to non-technical audiences.• An autonomous and proactive working style, combined with a strong sense of ownership.• Excellent English skills (C1–C2 level). German is a plus.What we offer?• Real Flexibility: A beautiful office in Berlin-Mitte (with an in-house gym!) and a hybrid setup that actually respects work-life balance• High-End Tech: Sell a product at the cutting edge of AI and Predictive Analytics• Culture & Perks: Regular team off-sites, and a high-trust environment where feedback is a gift, not a chore• Real Time Off: Enjoy 30 days of vacation per year to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance• Culture of Trust: Work in a high-trust environment where open communication and constructive feedback are part of everyday life• Ownership & Autonomy: Take responsibility, make an impact, and enjoy a high degree of personal ownership in your roleAbout us7Learnings is one of the leading retail optimization platforms. We help retailers to optimize their pricing and marketing spend. Our solution uses advanced machine learning models to forecast demand for different price points with high accuracy. With our powerful self-learning algorithms, retailers can increase their profitability and revenues by up to 10%. We offer the most intuitive way to steer prices. Our prices simply maximize the business goals set by our clients. Our solution is easy to integrate and offers a high return on investment.

jobs.description: ABOUT THE ROLEIn our Certification & Safety team, you make sure that safety is designed into our next-generation Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS) from the start. Working closely with the engineering teams, you carry safety requirements through the entire development lifecycle, from the first hazard assessment to the certification evidence.As a senior engineer, you handle complex safety tasks independently and bring your practical experience into technical discussions and design decisions.WHAT YOU WILL DO • Perform aircraft- and system-level safety assessments, including FHA, PSSA, SSA, FTA, FMEA and Common Cause Analyses • Identify and classify failure conditions, derive safety requirements and support their allocation to systems and equipment • Evaluate system architectures, failure modes, redundancy concepts and mitigation measures • Support the determination of Functional and Item Development Assurance Levels (FDAL/IDAL) • Work with engineering teams, suppliers and certification specialists to implement and verify safety requirements • Prepare and review safety documentation and evidence for certification and design reviews • Help improve our safety engineering practices and support colleagues with your expertiseWHAT YOU BRING • A degree in Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field • Deep, hands-on experience in aerospace safety engineering and safety assessment methods (FHA, PSSA, FTA, FMEA, CCA) • Solid knowledge of ARP4761/ARP4761A and ARP4754A/B • Experience translating safety assessment results into engineering requirements and architectural decisions • The ability to define, communicate and execute robust safety processes independently in a dynamic startup environment • Clear communication across engineering disciplines and a thorough, diligent way of working • Fluent EnglishMoreover, it would be helpful if you also• have experience with UAS, EASA SC Light-UAS, Design Verification Reports (DVR) or military airworthiness requirements• know DO-178C/DO-254 and development assurance processes• are familiar with safety analysis tools such as Isograph FaultTree+ and requirements management tools such as Polarion• have worked directly with aviation certification authorities• speak GermanWHAT WE OFFER • Full-scale aerospace engineering, not concept slides • A 60+ engineer team at Ottobrunn • Real ownership and flat hierarchies: a modern startup culture where your input shapes decisions, not just execution • Flexible working hours, remote work, and competitive compensation • Health & wellbeing: EGYM Wellpass membership and subsidized lunch in our canteen • Office extras: espresso coffee, fresh fruit, and soft drinks, plus regular team and company events, and plenty more once you're on boardAbout usclick here!Built for purpose.When time matters.ERC was founded to close Europe's critical capability gap in the sky. Two full-scale demonstrators. Two EU records. Built for the missions that cannot wait.

jobs.occupation: PhD Positions in Agentic AI for Medical Image Analysis (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description: The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.The Division of Medical Image Computing (MIC) at the German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) in Heidelberg, starting in January 2027, is offering PhD Positions in Agentic AI for Medical Image Analysis.The Division of Medical Image Computing (MIC) is recruiting PhD candidates to develop AI agents that interpret medical images, use analysis tools, evaluate intermediate results, and adapt their approach based on evidence and feedback.Candidates will join a collaborative research environment with clinical partners, extensive computing infrastructure, and connections to initiatives such as Helmholtz Imaging.Your TasksWe investigate how AI agents can combine medical images with clinical information, plan and execute analytical steps, learn from feedback, assess intermediate results, and respond appropriately to uncertainty or failure. Approaches may include reinforcement learning, multimodal learning, vision-language models, planning, tool-augmented language models, probabilistic modelling, and classical medical image analysis.Candidates may work primarily in one of several application areas:1. multimodal agents for prostate cancer diagnosis and treatment support;2. auditable analysis of longitudinal imaging for tumour-response assessment;3. federated multimodal agents connecting oral imaging with systemic health information; or4. or reinforcement learning for agents that navigate and integrate complex data across medical and other scientific domains.The individual PhD topic will be developed jointly based on the candidate’s interests, expertise, and the methodological questions arising across these applications.You will:- develop agents that combine medical images with clinical text and other information;- investigate reinforcement learning for planning, tool use, feedback integration, and iterative improvement;- apply agentic methods to segmentation, annotation, quantitative analysis, or scientific data exploration;- establish rigorous evaluation methods covering accuracy, robustness, generalisation, uncertainty calibration, failure detection, and appropriate abstention; and- collaborate with methodological and clinical researchers, publish your results, and contribute reusable software or benchmarks.Your ProfileYou should have:- A master’s degree in computer science, data science, mathematics, physics, engineering, or a related discipline- A strong foundation in machine learning and strong Python programming skills- Practical experience with a deep-learning framework such as PyTorch- Experience in at least one relevant area, such as reinforcement learning, computer vision, language models, multimodal learning, or medical-image analysis- An analytical and collaborative working style and good communication skills in EnglishPrevious experience with medical data is helpful but not required. We also welcome candidates with strong machine-learning fundamentals who want to develop expertise in agentic AI.What you can excpect:- Scientific freedom to develop your own methodological research question- Close supervision and exchange within a cohort of PhD researchers- Access to extensive GPU infrastructure, medical-imaging resources, and established research software- Collaboration with international machine-learning and clinical partners- Support for conference participation, open-source contributions, and professional development- Fully funded PhD submissionPlease submit:- your CV- academic transcripts- a brief research statement of no more than one page describing a question in agentic AI that interests you- your preferred application area, or a ranking of the available areas- your master’s thesis or another representative piece of scientific work- links to relevant publications, software, or code repositories, if available- Instead of a generic motivation letter, please use your research statement to explain which scientific question you would like to investigate, why it matters, and how you might approach itWe Offer- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level- Access to international research networks- Doctoral salary with the usual social benefits- 30 days of vacation per year- Flexible working hours- Possibility of part-time work- Family-friendly working environment- Sustainable travel to work: subsidized Germany job ticket- Unleash your full potential: targeted training and mentoring through the DKFZ International PhD Program and DKFZ Career Service- Our Corporate Health Management Program offers a holistic approach to your well-beingAre you interested?Then become part of the DKFZ and join us in contributing to a life without cancer!Contact:Constantin Ulrich HarsyPhone: +49 (0) 6221/42-3552Duration: The positions are initially limited to 3 years.Application Deadline: December 2, 2026Applications by e-mail cannot be accepted.Please also note that we cannot return applications submitted by post.We are convinced that an innovative research and working environment thrives on the diversity of its employees. Therefore, we welcome applications from talented people, regardless of gender, cultural background, nationality, ethnicity, sexual identity, physical ability, religion and age. People with severe disabilities are given preference if they have the same aptitude.Notice: We are subject to the regulations of the Infection Protection Act (IfSG).
